doc: Domed lid seen only from above: thin sheet of revolution (underside = top - t, t from the prior grid), a strap (arched handle) over it whose ends run down into the sheet, small balls. Strap = the largest residual cluster above the sheet that is longer than min_extent*s in the sheet plane. Balls = generic free-fit balls. Reproduces hand kit A' (prim_potlid.build_lid, variant fit) apart from the balls. Windows: the hand kit's absolute windows divided by s of its development episode (GT-free); whether each hand-kit window was set before or after a scan scoring of that kit is not recorded (work-log: two dev scorings per family) - treat them as development choices, not as tuned-free.
